pull.title: KAFKA-20925: Use Request Header v3 for AlterPartition, AssignReplicasToDirs, AllocateProducerIds and ControllerRegistration
pull.body:
Jira: https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/KAFKA-20925

KIP-1313:
https://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/spaces/KAFKA/pages/406624038/KIP-1313+Client+instance+ID+in+all+request+headers

This PR adds new versions of AlterPartition, AssignReplicasToDirs,
AllocateProducerIds and ControllerRegistration that use the v3 request
header. Brokers and controllers send the new
versions only when the metadata version is 4.5-IV0 or later.
